### CLI

| | |
|---|---|
| [steward ack](steward_ack.qmd) | Accept an open item, so that nothing reports it again. |
| [steward init](steward_init.qmd) | Create a Steward workspace. |
| [steward runbook](steward_runbook.qmd) | Print the agent runbook that ships with the package. |
| [steward status](steward_status.qmd) | Report where the run stands, and what the next turn would do. |
| [steward tasks](steward_tasks.qmd) | Enumerate the tasks an eval set definition resolves to. |
| [steward tend](steward_tend.qmd) | Run one turn of the supervision loop. |
